subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Resilience

options.text: The confidence to go abroad alone without any help
The ability to deal with any kind of hardship and recover from its effects
The determination to laugh at one's own self
The ability to defeat anyone in argument

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Resilience"** refers to the ability to deal with any kind of hardship and recover from its effects. (लचीलापन) • **English Meaning: **Resilience is the capacity to quickly recover from difficulties or adapt well to adverse situations. • **Hindi Meaning: **कठिनाइयों से उबरने और प्रतिकूल परिस्थितियों में समायोजित होने की क्षमता। • **Example: **After losing her job, her resilience helped her find a new career path within months. • The correct option explains the word accurately, reflecting its essence of adaptability and recovery. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: The confidence to go abroad alone without any help** (अकेले विदेश जाने का आत्मविश्वास) • **Explanation: **This definition describes confidence and independence, not resilience. • **Example: **She had the confidence to travel abroad for her education without any assistance. • **Option 3: The determination to laugh at one's own self** (अपने आप पर हंसने का दृढ़ संकल्प) • **Explanation: **This describes self-humor and humility, which is unrelated to resilience. • **Example: **Being able to laugh at his mistakes showed his humility and self-confidence. • **Option 4: The ability to defeat anyone in argument** (किसी को भी तर्क में हराने की क्षमता) • **Explanation: **This definition refers to debating skills and does not align with the meaning of resilience. • **Example: **Her ability to defeat opponents in debates made her a strong candidate for the competition. 3a:Tbfd, The correct answer is: **Haughty**.
